resource.description: Current conditions snapshot: GitHub stats for 6 agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, MCP servers), OpenAI/Anthropic/GitHub/Cursor status and incidents, MCP Registry entries updated in the last hour, npm weekly downloads (@modelcontextprotocol/sdk, @x402/core, @x402/xrpl) and XRPL mainnet server_info. Weather-style indices (visibility, pressure), per-source timestamps, data gaps and a confidence score (not yet calibrated) plus a separate data-quality score. Also: x402 payment activity on XRPL mainnet from our own ledger scan (t54-tagged payments, volume per asset, unique payers/merchants, heuristic real-vs-automated split with per-merchant concentration), plus 24h/7d baselines, baseline-relative temperature/pressure and fronts. JSON, cached up to 5 minutes.
